title: 第二章   一块破石头而已
content_zh:
想到自己在苍月大陆堂堂渡劫高手，竟然被别人讨债，虽然是这具身体的前主人，但陈木的脸色依然变得有些冷。

    “余北，我劝你少管闲事，陈木以前是大少爷，两万块钱自然是给他的，现在陈木已经不是陈家的少爷了，凭什么那我们谢少的钱，他算个什么东西？”谢德少没有说话，不过他旁边的一名小黄毛却嘲讽道。

    “你。。。”余北被小黄毛呛的不知道说什么好，毕竟让他拿出两万块钱给陈木还债是不可能的，但余北也不想看着自己的好兄弟就这么被人欺负，余北脸色顿时涨的通红。

    “哼，余北，你还是不要出来丢人现眼了，你一个农村来的，还想给陈木出头，你还真把自己当个人物了？”谢德少冷眼看了眼余北，丝毫不给余北任何面子

    “陈少爷，睡得可好？”谢德少看着依然还躺在床上没有说话的陈木，微微一笑道。

    “尚可。”陈木微微沉思了一番，如果这些人要动手的话，虽然陈木现在只有练气一层的实力，但对付这些普通人，根本不足为据，但陈木同样知道，这个星球似乎有着法律，不能杀人，不然陈木不介意将这些他有些讨厌的蝼蚁给顺手杀掉。

    “那陈少，可想好了怎么偿还我的两万块钱？”谢德少依然笑道，他不怕陈木没钱还，他知道陈木有一个陈家玉坠，这是他通过小道消息打听来的，每一个陈家的人，在家族内成年后，都会给一个代表陈家的玉坠，这块玉坠打造的十分惊喜，每一块这种玉坠至少价值几十万元，这也只有作为燕京三大家族之一的陈家才有这种实力，才有这种财力可以做到这个地步。

    谢德少本来想给陈木发一些红包，通过陈木接触陈家的人，谢德少知道陈木是一个草包，很好打发，而且喜欢吹嘘，只要迎合一些，一切都手到擒来，不过他没想到陈木竟然被陈家赶了出来，这让谢德少有些措手不及外，只能转而将目标转到陈家的玉坠上，谢德少的父亲就是在宁华市做生意，而且成立了一家有些规模的公司，所以谢德少的生意头脑自然十分精明，他不会让自己吃一点亏，而且会让自己的利益最大化。

    “没有。”陈木依然面无表情的回到，不过却根本没有将谢德少当回事，他可以在谢德少动手的一瞬间，将谢德少杀一百遍，虽然陈木不会杀谢德少，但打晕他花的时间估计更短，所以陈木根本没有将谢德少当回事，他也不配让陈木这种曾经在苍月大陆顶尖的修真者当回事。

    听到陈木的话，谢德少没有任何意外，他早就知道陈木身上绝不可能有钱，而那名给他钱的讨厌的女人，每次给他的钱不超过三千块钱，所以他根本不担心陈木能还得起这个钱。

    “既然陈少你没有两万块钱，同学一场，我也不想继续问你要钱，你将你脖子上的玉坠摘下来给我就行了。”

    谢德少说完，看着陈木脖子上挂着的玉坠眼冒金星，这东西可不是两万块钱能买到的，不说这种玉坠只有陈家弟子成年后才会发配，就是这块玉坠本身的价值就不菲。
content_en:
Thinking that he, a master of overcoming tribulations in Cang Yue Continent, was being asked for debts by others, even though he was the former owner of this body, Chen Mu's face still turned a little cold.

"Yu Bei, I advise you to mind your own business. Chen Mu used to be the eldest young master, so the 20,000 yuan was naturally given to him. Now Chen Mu is no longer the young master of the Chen family. Why does our young master Xie's money count?" Mr. Xie Des did not speak, but a young man next to him mocked.

"You..." Yu Bei was choked by Xiao Huangmao and didn't know what to say. After all, it was impossible for him to give 20,000 yuan to repay Chen Mu's debt, but Yu Bei didn't want to see his good brother being bullied like this. Yu Bei's face suddenly turned red.

"Hmph, Yu Bei, you better not come out and embarrass yourself. You come from a rural area and you still want to stand up for Chen Mu. Do you really think of yourself as a person?" Mr. Xie looked at Yu Bei coldly and did not give Yu Bei any face.

"Master Chen, did you sleep well?" Mr. Xie Des looked at Chen Mu who was still lying on the bed and said nothing, and said with a smile.

"It's acceptable." Chen Mu pondered for a while. If these people wanted to take action, although Chen Mu now only has the strength of the first level of Qi training, it would not be enough to deal with these ordinary people. However, Chen Mu also knew that this planet seemed to have laws and no one could kill people. Otherwise, Chen Mu would not mind killing these ants that he hated.

"Then Mr. Chen, have you figured out how to repay me the 20,000 yuan?" Mr. Xie Des still smiled. He was not afraid that Chen Mu would not have the money to pay back. He knew that Chen Mu had a Chen family jade pendant, which he found out through the gossip. Every member of the Chen family, after reaching adulthood in the family,, will give a jade pendant representing the Chen family. This jade pendant is very surprising. Each jade pendant is worth at least hundreds of thousands of yuan. Only the Chen family, one of the three major families in Yanjing, has this kind of strength and the financial resources to do this.

Mr. Xie Des originally wanted to send some red envelopes to Chen Mu and contact the Chen family through Chen Mu. Mr. Xie knew that Chen Mu was a loser, easy to get rid of, and liked to brag. As long as he catered to some, everything would be easy for him. However, he did not expect that Chen Mu would be kicked out by the Chen family, which made Mr. Xie a little surprised.With nothing to do, he could only turn his target to the Chen family's jade pendant. Xie Desao's father was doing business in Ninghua City and established a company of some size, so Xie Desao's business acumen was naturally very shrewd. He would not let himself suffer any losses, and would maximize his own interests.

"No." Chen Mu returned expressionlessly, but he did not take Shao Xie seriously at all. He could kill Shao Xie a hundred times the moment Shao Xie took action. Although Chen Mu would not kill Shao Xie, it would probably take less time to knock him out, so Chen Mu did not take Shao Xie seriously at all, and he was not worthy of Chen Mu, a cultivator who was once the top cultivator in Cang Yue Continent.

Hearing Chen Mu's words, Mr. Xie Des was not surprised. He had known for a long time that Chen Mu would never have money, and the annoying woman who gave him money would not give him more than three thousand yuan each time, so he was not worried at all that Chen Mu could afford to repay the money.

"Since Mr. Chen, you don't have 20,000 yuan, I don't want to continue asking you for money. Just take off the jade pendant from your neck and give it to me."

After Mr. Xie Des finished speaking, his eyes flashed as he looked at the jade pendant hanging around Chen Mu's neck. This thing cannot be bought with twenty thousand yuan. Not only that this kind of jade pendant is only distributed to disciples of the Chen family after they reach adulthood, but the jade pendant itself is worth a lot of money.
title_en: Chapter 2 Just a piece of broken stone
